Chuck, saw HungerRush shipped TextAI and a native Grubhub integration on top of DoorDash and Uber Eats.

Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for HungerRush off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

As the platform adds AI ordering and more marketplace channels, the addressable list grows faster than the sales team does. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to cover it, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter gets tight.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings HungerRush needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
